name: agent-nudge
description: A daemon that finds idle Claude and Codex sessions in tmux and asks them, once, whether their goal is done.

interface.shortDescription: Wake idle coding agents in tmux that stopped short of their goal.
interface.longDescription: A per-machine daemon that watches Claude Code and Codex sessions in tmux, and when one sits idle after its turn, types one polite question into it: is your goal done, or are you blocked? Dry-run by default.
defaultPrompt: Start the agent nudger on this machine.
Show what the nudger did today.
